guest.heroTitle: Turn paper sheet music into digital scores, then practice right in your browser
guest.heroLead: Digitize from photos or PDFs, fix every note, listen back and track your progress, all in your own language.
guest.dropNow: Drop the file to get started
guest.dropHint: Or drop images, PDF, MusicXML or MIDI here
guest.loadFailed: Couldn't load the home page data. You can still sign in to get started.
guest.featuredLead: The scores people care about most, favoring new ones with many views. Sign in to open, listen and practice.
guest.featuredEmpty: No public scores yet. Be the first to share one!
guest.composersLead: The composers with the most public scores on the platform.
guest.howLead: Three steps from a paper score to a practice session.

capture.title: Capture
capture.text: Take a photo or upload a PDF of your paper score. The system recognizes the notes and turns them into a digital score.

edit.title: Edit
edit.text: Fix each note in the editor, listen back right away and save multiple versions.

practice.title: Practice
practice.text: Practice slowly, loop the hard parts and track your streak and practice time.

guest.statsLead: Counted live from the system, refreshed every 5 minutes.

prepare.q: What do I need to digitize a score?
prepare.a: A clear photo or a PDF file. You can also import an existing MusicXML or MIDI file directly.

privacy.q: Can other people see my scores?
privacy.a: No. Scores are private by default. You choose to share them with a link, invite people by email, or request publishing for an administrator to approve.

price.a: The app is in a trial period and free to use. Paid plans will be announced later.

mobile.q: Can I use it on my phone?
mobile.a: Yes. The interface adapts to your screen, and the bottom tab bar opens Explore, Library and Practice quickly.

guest.finalTitle: Ready to digitize your first score?
guest.featuresLead: From paper sheet to stage, in a single app.

ocr.title: Digitize from photos and PDFs
ocr.text: Snap a page of music; the system recognizes the notes and builds an editable digital score.

editor.title: Score editor
editor.text: Edit notes, staves and lyrics; keep multiple versions and compare them.

player.title: Instant playback
player.text: Play with many instruments, change tempo, loop the hard parts.

practice.title: Scored practice
practice.text: Play along, get accuracy and timing scores, review your history and practice streak.

teams.title: Teams and shows
teams.text: Assign roles and parts, and follow the whole group on one score.

export.title: Export anywhere
export.text: PDF, MIDI, audio, SVG, MusicXML in a few clicks.

guest.demoTitle: See the score viewer in action
guest.demoLead: The playhead sweeps the staff, each note lights up on cue, and you get scored as you play along.
guest.demoCaption: Illustration: a playhead sweeps across the staff and notes light up one by one as they play.
